field-name.purpose: App names on Home colour fields; later apps use clamp(22px, 2.3vw, 30px).

numeral.purpose: Two-digit section numbers in the Prose outline, page numbers in the Jotbook page strip, sheet numbers in the Cells sheet strip and slide numbers in the Deck timeline and sorter; the suite signature.

headline.purpose: Document H1 and the Jotbook note title.

title.purpose: Document H2, crash fallback heading, empty-note heading.

body-document.purpose: Paragraphs on the page and in the Jotbook note, in Ink 2.

cell.purpose: Cells grid text and the in-cell editor, Geist with tabular figures so number columns align.

label.purpose: Buttons, menu items, toasts, New sheet, filter values.

caption.purpose: Meta, descriptions, status bar and selection figures, tooltips, field-row labels, note date line, search location and count, function descriptions, the dialog problem line.

mono-formula.purpose: The active cell's contents in the Cells formula line.

mono-address.purpose: The cell address box, function names in suggestions and the argument signature; Deck's planned-time field and text size value.

mono-figure.purpose: Word counts, find counts, zoom value, page numbers, key caps, strip dates and row counts, search-hit dates, chart range labels, Deck's timeline and sorter times (the timeline total at 12px). Figures only.

stamp.purpose: Uppercase mono document state; the only uppercase mono text.

present-clock.purpose: Elapsed time in Deck's presenter view, white on the black stage; a numeral, so Geist rather than mono.

slide-number.purpose: The Section layout number, 200px in the theme accent text. Slide pixels on the 1280 by 720 surface.

slide-title.purpose: The Title layout title (80px); Statement is 76px and Section title 60px with the same line height and tracking.

slide-heading.purpose: Slide titles in Title and points and Two columns (54px); Picture title is 44px. Line height 1.08 from 40px, tracking -0.03em from 40px.

slide-body.purpose: Subtitle and points (30px), two-column points (28px), caption (24px); line height 1.32 below 40px. Bullets are squares in the theme accent.

slide-footer.purpose: Deck title and the mono "03 / 07" count in theme muted, 96px in and 30px from the bottom, on every layout except Title and Statement.

stage-title.purpose: The Dashboard Continue Stage title: 42px/800, 0.96, -0.04em, two lines at most, balanced.

strip-name.purpose: App names in the Dashboard app strip fields: 22px/800, line height 1, -0.03em.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no drop shadows. Floating layers use a 1px Seam border; transient tools invert to ink.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind the command palette and dialogs (a dim, not a shadow).

shadows.name: rail-hover
shadows.purpose: Rail switch hover over the field colour.

shadows.name: rail-current
shadows.purpose: Current app switch in the rail.

shadows.name: rail-hover-ink
shadows.purpose: Rail switch hover on the Suite Ink rail of Home and the Dashboard, where darkening would not show.

shadows.name: rail-current-ink
shadows.purpose: Current switch on the Suite Ink rail (the Dashboard switch while the Dashboard is open).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing: exponential ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Hover fills, menus, "/" menu, popovers, tooltips.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Palette, find bar, toasts, rail colour change, numeral and bar updates, focus-mode dimming, template lift.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: Floating layers enter by dropping 4px on the vertical axis.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Toasts rise 6px into place.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Dialog scrim fades in at 160ms; the dialog plane itself drops 4px at 200ms.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Template thumbnails lift 4px on hover/focus while the border turns the template's app field (vermilion for documents, cobalt for workbooks).

motion.name: grid-glide
motion.purpose: Cells selection frame and fill handle glide to the new cell or range; the one step faster than 160ms so keyboard movement never lags.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Marching-ants outline around copied or cut cells until the paste.

motion.name: chart-grow
motion.purpose: Chart series grow in and update when their cells change; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: tools-rise
motion.purpose: Deck: the selected object's tools (and the slide tools on deselect) rise into the command bar.

motion.name: timeline-resize
motion.purpose: Deck: every timeline block eases to its new share of planned seconds when a slide's time changes; numeral colour 200ms, block edge and fill 160ms.

motion.name: sorter-fade
motion.purpose: Deck: the slide sorter fades in over the work area.

motion.name: present-crossfade
motion.purpose: Deck: each slide fades in when presenting; the only transition between slides.

motion.name: present-cursor
motion.purpose: Deck: the elapsed-time cursor on the presenting band moves with the half-second clock.

motion.name: present-hud
motion.purpose: Deck: the presenting HUD shows when the pointer moves and fades away.

motion.name: dash-dwell
motion.purpose: Dashboard: resting the pointer on a strip item or an Also recent row puts it on the stage; leaving sooner cancels; focus stages it at once. A delay, not an animation.

motion.name: dash-stage-fade
motion.purpose: Dashboard: the new preview fades in when the stage changes; the old one is replaced, not cross-faded.

motion.name: dash-band
motion.purpose: Dashboard: the stage frame's 10px field band changes to the staged app's field.

motion.name: dash-go-nudge
motion.purpose: Dashboard: the Continue / Open button arrow moves 3px right on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, including the grid glide, the copy marquee, chart grow-in, the Deck tools rise, timeline resize, sorter fade, presenting cross-fade and band cursor, and the Dashboard's stage fade, band colour change and arrow nudge.

breakpoints.name: cells-tool-labels
breakpoints.purpose: Cells: Sort, Filter and Chart labels hide; those tools become 32px icon buttons.

breakpoints.name: deck-tool-labels
breakpoints.purpose: Deck: labels of plain tool buttons (Slide, Text, Shape, Picture, Sorter; Fill, Outline, Replace, Arrange) hide and those tools become 32px icon buttons. Layout and Theme keep labels.

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-search-label
breakpoints.purpose: Command bar hides the search label.

breakpoints.name: deck-export-label
breakpoints.purpose: Deck: the Export label hides; Export becomes a 32px outline icon menu.

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-lists-align
breakpoints.purpose: Prose: list toggles and alignment button leave the bar; title input narrows to 180px.

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-pickers
breakpoints.purpose: Jotbook: notebook and section pickers narrow from 180px to 132px. Deck: the deck picker keeps 180px.

breakpoints.name: cells-insert-label
breakpoints.purpose: Cells: the Insert label hides.

breakpoints.name: cells-align
breakpoints.purpose: Cells: the alignment menu leaves the bar (alignment stays in Ctrl K).

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-app-name
breakpoints.purpose: Shared: app name and crumb slashes leave the bar (Jotbook pickers stay).

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-labels
breakpoints.purpose: Shared: button labels hide; Insert and PDF become 32px icon buttons. Cells: the workbook title narrows to 124px. Deck: the Layout and Theme menus lose their labels here.

breakpoints.name: cmdbar-style
breakpoints.purpose: Prose: style picker narrows from 120px to 104px.

breakpoints.name: home-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Home title goes full width and the lede drops below it.

breakpoints.name: canvas-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Editor canvas left inset grows from 72px to 144px (two columns).

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.purpose: Forces light tokens in both themes and renders only the page.

breakpoints.name: deck-timeline-block
breakpoints.purpose: Deck: on timeline blocks this narrow the planned time moves under the numeral.

breakpoints.name: deck-print
breakpoints.value: @media print, one 1280 by 720 page per slide
breakpoints.purpose: Deck PDF export: page size injected at export; only the slides render, in their slide theme.

breakpoints.name: dash-frame
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard: stage frame height, leaving room for the Also recent heading and first row at common window sizes; clamp(320px, calc(100vh - 340px), 520px) under 1080px.

breakpoints.name: dash-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard: the stage takes all 12 columns, the three app strips sit in a row under it, Also recent drops to two columns.

breakpoints.name: dash-status
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard: per-app counts leave the status bar.

breakpoints.name: dash-single
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard: grid pads 20px 24px, strips and Also recent go to one column, the figures row wraps.

chartSeries.purpose: Chart series in order; the first is always the Cells accent. Value-axis gridlines per theme; the category axis is a Seam line with no gridlines.

referenceOutlines.purpose: Each range a formula names, in order, while the formula is edited: a 1.5px outline over a 9% tint. Theme-aware; every colour clears 3:1 on its page.

cellFills.purpose: User cell fills; always #111 text and an 8% ink cell edge.

cellText.purpose: User cell text colours; lifted to the dark values on the graphite page. Text on a filled cell stays #111 unless a colour was chosen.

paper.decoration: bar: 64 by 10px accent, 30px above the title

sun.decoration: rule: 3px text colour across the margins, 76px above the bottom

cobalt.decoration: band: 18px accent down the left edge

grid.decoration: grid: twelve columns in 1px #ECECEA on both edges, plus the bar

slideThemes.purpose: Deck slide themes: content, not chrome. They do not follow the UI theme and export unchanged to .pptx and PDF. Type in the accent resolves to accentText. Colour menus offer Theme text, Theme muted, Theme accent, then the fixed colours, and None for fills and outlines. Each theme also sets the editing marks drawn over its slides: select (selection outline and handle stroke, handles filled with the background) and guide (snap guides, columns at 40%), each 3:1 or better on the ground, the same in light and graphite UI.

presenting.purpose: Deck presenting, identical in both UI themes.

narrative.overview:
Paperlight is International Typographic Style applied to an office suite. Every screen sits on a visible modular grid; structure is carried by scale (oversized numerals and grotesk headlines), by 1px ink hairlines, and by flat full-height colour fields that tell you which app you are in. There is no icon ribbon, no white page floating on a grey shadowed void, no rounded card. The page is a 794px A4 sheet with a 1px ink edge, set on a canvas ruled every 72px.

The density is that of a calm working tool: a 64px colour rail, a 56px command bar, a 264px outline column and a 32px status bar frame the document, and almost everything else hides in selection, "/" and Ctrl K. Colour is rare and loud: one app field per app, the accent repeated only where it means "you are here" or "this needs you". Everything else is white ground (or graphite in dark) and #111 ink. Screens must survive a compressed screen recording on a phone, which is why outline numerals, field colours and stamp text all clear legibility floors rather than sitting at whisper contrast.

Motion is one axis, short and exponential: things drop 4px into place or rise 6px, never bounce, never scale.
keyCharacteristics: Visible grid: 72px column rules on the editor canvas, 12 columns with 24px gutters on Home and the Dashboard, drawn on both edges of each column; in Cells the spreadsheet's own 30px cell rules are the grid.
Square everything (0px radius) and 1px ink hairlines in place of shadows.
One flat colour field per app (Prose vermilion, Cells cobalt, Deck sun, Jotbook viridian), full height in the rail.
Geist grotesk at extreme scale contrast: 96px/800 display against 13px/500 labels.

Ordered work is numbered: Prose sections, Jotbook pages, Cells sheets and Deck slides carry 42px/800 numerals with their length beside them (a 4px bar in the outline and strips, the block's own width in the Deck timeline), and the current one turns to the app's accent text.
Document state is stamped in mono, always visible, never a toast.
Light and graphite dark themes share the same fields; print and PDF are always light.

rules.name: The One Field Per App Rule
rules.body: Each app owns exactly one flat colour field and it fills the full-height rail. The current app's field is the accent; Home's and the Dashboard's accent is Suite Ink. Field colours are never gradients, tints or decoration.

rules.name: The Text-Weight Accent Rule
rules.body: A field colour used as text, or as a thin line that must read like text, switches to its app's text variant, the accent-text role: Vermilion Text (#C2311A light, #F26B54 dark) in Prose, Viridian Text (#0B7A6C light, #3FBFA9 dark) in Jotbook, Cobalt Text (#2448D8 light, #7D97FF dark) in Cells, Deck Text (#8C6A00 light, #F2C230 dark) in Deck. The current numeral in the Prose outline, the Jotbook page strip, the Cells sheet strip and the Deck timeline and sorter always takes the text variant, never the field colour, and so do the Cells selection frame, fill handle, editor frame and copy marquee and the Deck insertion marks and template hover edge. Sun shows itself only as a fill (the chip, the current-block tint, the band); its text variant carries everything thin. Any new field colour must clear 4.5:1 against its on-colour before it ships, and any new app defines its text variant alongside it; Deck takes #111 ink, the others white.

rules.name: The Slides Are Content Rule
rules.body: Slide themes are the deck's own palette, not chrome: they do not follow the light or graphite UI theme, and a slide looks the same on the canvas, in the sorter, when presenting and in .pptx and PDF. Inside a slide, type set in the accent resolves to the theme's accent text, and only the theme's colours or a fixed colour the user picked paint the slide.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Figures Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets numbers, keys, dates and the state stamp; in Cells the machine text a formula is made of: the cell address, the formula line, function names and signatures in suggestions, and chart range labels; in Deck the standalone times and counts: timeline and sorter times, the timeline total, the planned-time field, the figure in "Use 0:12", the text size value, the slide footer count and the presenting HUD figures. Times that sit inside a worded line (the Deck status bar, the notes footer, presenter-view labels) stay Geist with tabular figures, and numerals and the presenter clock are Geist 800. Cell text, the in-cell editor, function descriptions, header letters and every worded label, heading, message or button are Geist.

rules.name: The Numbered Work Rule
rules.body: Ordered work carries one numeral: two digits at 42px/800, 0.84 line height, -0.04em, tabular, in Numeral Grey. Prose sections in the outline, Jotbook pages and Cells sheets in the strip, and Deck slides in the timeline and sorter all use it, and the current one turns to the app's text variant (Vermilion Text, Viridian Text, Cobalt Text, Deck Text), never the field colour, changing at 200ms. Length sits beside the numeral and is measured, never decorative: a 4px bar in the outline and strips, the block's own width in the timeline.

rules.name: The Scale Carries Structure Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and weight jumps (96 to 42 to 13), not from colour, boxes or icons. Uppercase tracked text is reserved for state (stamp, field status) and command-palette group headings; it never sits above a heading as a label.

rules.name: The Hairlines Instead Of Shadows Rule
rules.body: A floating layer is a flat ground plane with a 1px ink border. If it needs more separation, invert it to ink; never add a shadow or blur.

dos: Do draw the grid: 72px column rules on work canvases, 12 columns with 24px gutters on overview screens, lines on both column edges.
Do give every new app (Cells, Deck, Jotbook) its own field colour in the rail and reuse every other token unchanged.

Do check every field colour against its on-colour at 4.5:1 or better, and use the app's text variant for accent text: #C2311A / #F26B54 in Prose, #0B7A6C / #3FBFA9 in Jotbook, #2448D8 / #7D97FF in Cells, #8C6A00 / #F2C230 in Deck.

Do set the current numeral in the outline, the strips, the timeline and the sorter in accent text, and keep inactive numerals at Numeral Grey (#8F8F8C light, #6A6A6A dark) or darker so they read at 3:1 after compression.
Do keep exactly one filled ink control per command bar, and keep every command reachable from Ctrl K when the bar sheds controls.
Do stamp document state (Saved, Unsaved, Exported, with time) in the mono stamp, always visible; autosaving apps seed the time from the last edit.

Do route every delete that can't be undone (Jotbook pages, sections and notebooks; Cells sheets) through a confirm dialog: Cancel first and focused, a spacer, the danger text button last; deletes that Ctrl Z restores at once (Cells rows, columns, charts, cell contents) run straight away with no ellipsis.

Do move on one axis at 160 or 200ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and drop all motion under reduced motion (the grid glide, the copy marquee, chart grow-in, the object tools' rise, the timeline resize, the sorter fade, the presenting cross-fade and cursor, and the Dashboard's stage fade, band colour and arrow nudge included); the grid's selection frame and fill handle are the one faster step, gliding at 120ms on the same curve.
Do set every figure in the grid, the status bar, the strips, the timeline and on slides with tabular numerals.
Do render print and PDF in light tokens on A4 with 25.4mm margins, whatever the theme; Deck prints one slide per 1280 by 720 page in its slide theme.
Do size Deck's timeline blocks and presenting segments by planned seconds, so the shape of the talk is visible while it is built and while it is given.
Do dim every top-level block except the current one to 0.2 opacity in Focus mode.
Do keep the Dashboard's app strips on the latest work, not on the stage: pointing at an item changes only the stage, so nothing moves under the pointer.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, blur or glows to any layer; use a 1px ink border or ink inversion.
Don't round corners on any element, chart bars and tooltips included.

Don't use field colours as gradients, tints behind text, or decoration outside rails, fields, selection, selected items, search marks and the 10px identity swatches and bands that say which app a piece of work belongs to; current numerals use the text variant, not the field. Deck's 18% Sun tint marks only the current timeline block.
Don't set worded labels in Geist Mono.
Don't place uppercase tracked labels above headings.
Don't put Delete or Discard next to a commit action without space between them.
Don't fill a destructive button or menu item with Danger; danger is text weight only.
Don't let the UI theme or chrome tokens repaint a slide; slides keep their deck theme everywhere, exports included.
